title: Creator Anchor
description: Experimental (media_buy.social_profiles). A place the creator controls that confirms the operator's sales-authorization claim. A confirmed anchor makes the claim mutually attested. The evaluator checks the anchor with its own request, as the verify_brand_claim two-calls rule does for brand claims. It never relies on the issuer's statement that the anchor holds. A confirmed anchor confirms the profile at url. Where the platform addresses a profile by the subject's identifier, url MUST be that address. That is the case for youtube_channel_id, tiktok_id and instagram_handle. For instagram_account_id the link between url and the account is the issuer's statement. An anchor the evaluator cannot check leaves the credential operator-attested, not invalid.

url.description: HTTPS URL of the account's public profile page. Its registrable domain MUST equal the platform_domain of the credential's evidence. For a youtube_channel_id, tiktok_id or instagram_handle subject it MUST be the profile address built from the identifier, as the security documentation defines, or the anchor fails. For an instagram_account_id subject the evaluator cannot check that the page belongs to the account.

expected.description: Text the creator placed in the profile, such as a bio line naming the operator's domain. The evaluator confirms that the page at url contains this exact string.
